dog.description_text:
Foxy is a true companion dog and a future best buddy. He is happy in an apartment or a house, and he adjusts easily to whatever lifestyle you have.

Foxy is calm and well-mannered at home and behaves beautifully on daily errands. He walks nicely on a leash, and the word "walk" gets him excited. He's a good eater who finishes every meal, and he loves treats. He is easy to keep on a schedule, and by 8 p.m. he's already asleep. Most of the day you'll find him napping, ideally under a blanket, which he loves. He's also happy to wear clothes without any fuss.

His favorite things are belly rubs, slow massages, and peanut butter. He's ready for a massage at any time of day.

New sights and sounds can be a lot, so we're taking things slowly and letting him explore at his own pace. He takes a few brave steps every day. He's enthusiastic with new people and dogs but is still learning to say hello politely. He does best with slow introductions. His confidence grows each day.

This is by far the most well-adjusted foster I've had. He's a real keeper!

﻿Foxy is approximately 7y 0m 24d old and is fully grown at 8.3 pounds. They are microchipped and up to date on all age-appropriate medical care. Their breed is unknown as we have not had a DNA test done.

Although our dogs are listed as unknown breed, buildings with specific dog restrictions typically enforce their rules based on what breeds a dog appears to resemble. It's always important to keep that in mind and know your building's policies before adopting a dog.

This dog is available for adoption through Muddy Paws Rescue. If you're interested in adopting, the first thing you should do is begin the registration process at www.muddypawsrescue.org. If you are already a registered adopter with Muddy Paws Rescue, please email us at adoptionmeetings@muddypawsrescue.org.
